Not having any time to keep them up with waxing and plucking I thought it would be easier to just shave them off. Not such a bright idea as I think about it now but with 2 kids and no time...it did make things easier for me. Now that I'm older I now wanted to get a more natural look so decided to try to grow my eyebrows

One look at my brows and I was cranking away again at the bottom of the tube. I had to brush the moist applicator tip over my eyebrows a few times as very little serum came out.   I was impressed with how healthy and moisturized my eyebrows looked. They also look fuller. I've been using this product for nearly two months and have not really seen any results. The seller urges purchasers to reach out before leaving a negative review because they supposedly want everyone to be happy with the product, so I did before leaving this review, and they came back and told me I need to use it for six weeks on clean, dry brows, and that was it. Not helpful, so here's my honest review - not worth the money. I think I'm going back to RevitaBrow.

reviews.t: Product does NOT promise hair growth-- all listed benefits are about enhance APPEARANCE of existing hair
reviews.x: I'd love to say this did the trick, but it didn't. Having used Latisse for brow growth in the past, I have the ability to weigh actual growth vs hopeful thinking. I really wanted this product to knock Latisse results out of the water, since its so much cheaper, especially since I had the ability to test the product for free. Unfortunately, no such luck.  To be fair, the product does NOT promise hair growth-- all listed benefits are about enhance APPEARANCE of existing hair...so basically it's an

Unfortunately, the product didn't work for me. However, I am giving the company 5 stars for its excellent customer service. After you make your purchase, reBROW sends you emails every few weeks to check in on how the process is going. After about 7-8 weeks when I didn't see results, they were more than happy to refund the cost for me.  If you are on the fence about using this, you really have nothing to lose thanks to their satisfaction guarantee. Give it a shot!

claims.text: Many reviewers report slow but visible new brow growth after weeks of use.
A notable number of reviewers say the product did nothing for their brows.
Several users find the twist-dispenser difficult to use, with inconsistent or delayed product output.
Some reviewers praise the company's responsive customer service and follow-up.
Price is a concern for some, who find the product expensive.
